evidence: All 6 tests (5 probes + 1 summary) pass: `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture` reports 1 passed, 5 ignored (individual probes deferred to summary runner), 0 failed. Summary runner reports 5/5 probes passing.
Clippy clean: `cargo clippy -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- -D warnings` produces no warnings.
`cargo fmt --all --check` passes with no diff in the habitat geometry probe file.

All 5 acceptance-criteria scenarios present as named test functions with doc comments explaining ecological mechanisms: (1) `probe_biofilter_scaling_bigger_media_higher_capacity` — media area → nitrifier carrying capacity, (2) `probe_light_depth_shallow_vs_deep_growth` — Beer-Lambert attenuation, (3) `probe_habitat_fouling_glass_vs_filter` — photosynthesis vs organic-load-driven biofilm, (4) `probe_substrate_redox_denitrification` — suboxic rhizosphere denitrification, (5) `probe_equipment_scaling_1x_vs_2x` — proportional geometry scaling.

`format_habitat_debug` (line 44) dumps 8 structured sections on failure: habitat registry (area/flow/O₂/light per habitat), periphyton by habitat, decomposer by habitat, nitrifier biomass, filter state, substrate layers with O₂ penetration, denitrification metrics, and geometry dimensions. Called via `dump_habitat_debug` at probe boundaries.

`all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` (line 1618) runs all 5 probes, catches panics via `catch_unwind`, prints a structured pass/fail report with observed values and per-failure detail lines, and returns `Err` on any failure (non-zero exit).

Equipment scaling probe uses paired 1× vs 2× geometry with cubic stocking scaling (`size_scale.powi(3)` at line 1423: 10 → 80 adults), proportional feeding, both plant guilds, and 40% concentration tolerance via `record_within_fraction()`. Per-liter comparisons cover peak TAN, DO range, and final temperature.

Equipment scaling probe now includes geometry-aware plant biomass validation: footprint ratio is computed (line 1458), a `plant biomass vs footprint scaling` check verifies that 2× plant biomass tracks the footprint expansion within 40% tolerance (line 1536-1542), and the 2× envelope is scaled by `plant_footprint_scale` (lines 1564-1567).

Assertions throughout are directional (`>`) and envelope-based (min/max tolerance bands), not exact values: e.g., `capacity_large > capacity_small * 1.25` (biofilter), `growth_shallow > growth_deep` (light-depth), `record_within_fraction()` for equipment scaling. Resilient to reasonable retuning.
Substrate redox probe doc comment (lines 1055-1057) explicitly documents the inert control's aeration asymmetry and why this strengthens the comparison.
Summary output is structured and readable: `Probe N: name [PASS/FAIL]` with observed metric strings and failure detail lines, ending with pass/fail counts.
findings_or_gaps: The biofilter probe title says 'higher_capacity' but the observed summary shows `clearance not-cleared->not-cleared (terminal reduced-N fallback)` — neither arm fully clears within 28 days. The fallback path (lower terminal reduced-N + more nitrifier biomass) still validates the mechanism, and the title accurately reflects capacity rather than clearance speed. This is a cosmetic naming mismatch, not a functional gap.
